postconditions.description: The permutation A has length N.

postconditions.expression: all(x in range(1, N+1) for x in A)
postconditions.description: Each element in A is an integer from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(median(P_i) != median(P_{i+1}) for i in range(N-1))
postconditions.description: The median of each prefix P_i is not equal to the median of the next prefix P_{i+1} for all i from 1 to N-1.
